scope: Live private Photon room: rendered Editor host and two independent Realtime peers. Verifies transport, sender ownership, shared progress, late join and host handoff. Remote rendered UI and physical Android are not verified.

checks.name: Independent clients share an invisible private room
Native player retains local control ownership
Remote replica cannot consume host input
Optional tutorial opens without movement locking, starting a topic, or starting its clock
Tutorial, barrier reading and answer lists have visible native scrollbars
Only explicit tutorial acknowledgement marks it seen
Personal hint levels checkpoint for the requesting authenticated player
Delayed lower-sequence hint request is rejected
Three hint levels are capped and never add mistakes, pause, extend or reset the team deadline
Out-of-arena hint packet cannot mutate progress
Admin reset discards only the current problem's hint applicability
Pre-reset hint request cannot populate a fresh problem
Real wrong-answer submission identifies the incorrect truth-table row and retains mistake attribution
Remote capture hides math controls on the host and locks only the captured actor
Rajang uses original inference rules and the old development outcome selector is disabled
Late join does not regenerate the captured player's question
Another actor cannot spoof the captured player and a client boolean outcome cannot bypass math validation
Stale revision, malformed option and wrong hunt serial cannot resolve capture or alter its clock
Authority handoff preserves problem identity, personal hints and the exact original barrier deadline
Captured guest's correct inference answer enters the existing success outcome without damage
Success preserves arena work and its clock, causes no puzzle completion, and retains thirty-second nest sleep
Khezu uses a counterexample problem with an explicit no-counterexample option
Incorrect confirmed math answer holds the prison and delays damage until attack contact
Attack deducts exactly one heart at contact and transfers movement lock into the original five-second knockback/stun
Replaying a failed answer cannot deduct a second heart
Failure resumes the existing eligible-target flow without immediately rehunting its victim
Local barrier retains complete movement lock while another living player remains free
Correct answer after the original deadline is rejected
Expired barrier uses its existing failure timer, exactly one heart and explanatory timeout feedback
Barrier hints, answers and timeout never change topic mistake totals or its shared deadline
